name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.decodeNatAuxM_val
typeText:
∀ (c : Nat) (l : List.{0} Bool),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.val (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.decodeNatAuxM c l))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.decodeNatAux c l)

source.code:
theorem decodeNatAuxM_val : ∀ (c : ℕ) (l : List Bool),
    (decodeNatAuxM c l).val = decodeNatAux c l
  | c, [] => rfl
  | c, true :: l => by
      simp only [decodeNatAuxM, decodeNatAux, bind_val]
      exact decodeNatAuxM_val (c + 1) l
  | c, false :: l => by
      simp only [decodeNatAuxM, decodeNatAux, bind_val]
      rw [readBitsM_val]
      cases readBits c l with
      | none => rfl
      | some p =>
          obtain ⟨bs, rest⟩ := p
          simp only [bind_val, canonM_val, fromBitsM_val, pure_val]
